description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 6210017224468 DIFFUSER,LIGHT: Line 0001 Qty 45 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0078 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
